name: doruk-ai-harness
description: A coding harness for Claude Code. Work starts in discuss: loose, opinionated exploration to find a task's shape, with an optional structured-question round to pin down what's left. From there you build directly, or hand a multi-step build to orchestrate, which delegates every unit to model-tiered subagents and gates design and diff review with a different model. A committed .doruk/ state & memory layer (handoff, feature-roadmap, feature-organize, wrap) keeps context on disk, not in the chat window. Delegation hands work to other models in isolated git worktrees: codex (OpenAI) and gemini-delegate (Google), each a consultant or implementer. skills/meta/lean-instructions writes and audits instructions for frontier models. skills/browser/jev-browser drives a real browser with the Jev action model through the bundled jb CLI. Bundles 13 skills across six category dirs; skills/legacy/ keeps the superseded pre-Fable pipeline for reference.
